Alex: Morning team — quick async triage from me. Current numbers: 38 open tickets, 4 P1s (2 x duplicate billing, 1 x embeddings timeout, 1 x SSO login). Volume is +18% vs yesterday.
Priya: FYI I picked up the two duplicate billing tickets (2389, 2390). Used macro `billing-refund` and queued finance approval. Customer emails sent. :white_check_mark:
Elliot: Working on the embeddings timeout, root cause looks like a KV-cache eviction after the runtime kernel update last night. Repro locally with long-context payloads. Plan: roll back kernel patch on a canary node and validate.
OpsBot: Alert: 2026-03-02T07:23:12Z — spike in model inference errors (504) in eu-west-2, 3m avg error rate 12% — ticket created INC-6745.
Sam: I've got the SSO login P1. It's a config mismatch with the new IdP metadata; pushing a fix to staging now. Will validate and deploy to prod once Elliot confirms embeddings rollback won't collide with infra change.
Alex: Thanks. Quick ask re: macros — I updated `apology-with-refund` to include the new refund token and a short diagnostic checklist. Everyone please use that for billing dupes so we have consistent notes for finance.
Priya: Noted. Also added a new macro `kv-cache-reset` (temporary mitigation) — content below if you need it:

Steps:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/cache/reset -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"*","type":"kv"}'
2) Monitor inference errors for 10m
3) If errors persist, escalate to eng-runtime

Elliot: Good. I'll coordinate the canary rollback and run the `kv-cache-reset` on the canary before full rollback. ETA 45m for canary test.
Alex: If you need an oncall handoff, tag @oncall. Also, small logistic: afternoon support shift (14:00-22:00 UTC) — Priya covering, Sam backup. Please leave notes in the ticket if you hand off mid-shift.
Sam: On handoff — I'll document steps to reproduce for embeddings timeout and attach the kernel logs to INC-6745.
Priya: Blockers: waiting on finance to approve refunds (for the two billing tickets) and waiting on Elliot for canary rollback results. Everything else is moving.
Alex: Perfect. If anything turns critical, ping #incidents. Otherwise, we'll regroup in the 11:30 async check. :coffee:
